notes: Golden-star acceptance numbers for the pipeline end-to-end tests (tests/golden_checks.py, used by both test_golden_stars.py and test_golden_fixtures.py). These are the pipeline's OWN known answers — a change here means the pipeline's view of a known star changed, so scripts/check_expected_values.py flags any diff against the base branch in CI (flag, don't block). The rationale for each number lives in the golden_checks.py docstrings; this file holds the numbers.

150428135.name: TOI-700
150428135.notes: Planet c (16.05094 d) must be the headline signal; planet b (9.97706 d) must be a significant peak in the BLS spectrum itself (it ranks 12th-15th in peak extraction, so top-3 membership is the wrong assertion). 8.5 is the sweep HIT_SDE; 6.5 is the pipeline's own acceptance floor.

25155310.name: WASP-126
25155310.notes: Depth TRIPWIRE, not a validation: 0.631% is the pipeline's own long-standing measurement, NOT the catalog value (0.7006%). This detects that the search or flattening CHANGED, not that it is correct. Period must match the published 3.286 d.

308851365.name: EB (VSX ECLIPSING BINARY)
308851365.notes: The shape gate must NOT call the folded transit flat-bottomed (T23/T14 < 0.50) and the density flag must fire. The bound is deliberately NOT 'V-shaped' (<= 0.30): T23/T14 is numerically unstable on this smeared EB signal (see golden_checks.py check_eb docstring) — the never-U-shaped bound and the density flag are the stable measurements.
